Starter pens

Don't start from a blank file.

Every template below is a complete, working pen. Click one and it loads straight into the editor — HTML, CSS, and JS already wired up — so you can poke at it and watch the live preview react. They range from a pure-CSS animation to a canvas sketch to a small stateful app.

Browse the gallery

Click any card to open it in the editor. Your work autosaves locally, and you can fork, export, or share whatever you build from there.

How loading works

Forkbench encodes everything into the URL — no server, no accounts.

// Opening a template just sets the URL hash:
index.html#t=canvas-orbits

// Sharing your own pen base64-encodes the three sources:
index.html#pen=eyJ0IjoiTXkgUGVuIiwiaCI6Ii4uLiJ9…
